content: Standard IMO cadence: daily huddles (tactical blockers) -> weekly integration-leadership/steerco meeting (~90 min, IL + workstream leads review status/blockers/rolling 12-week lookahead) -> monthly steering committee (capital reallocation, risk posture) with a board/exec pack. IMO charter commits to: weekly dashboard, monthly board pack, Day-1-100 milestone tracker. Core recurring artifacts: integrated plan w/ milestones+gates, RAG status report w/ key changes, issue log (severity+owner), risk log (mitigation+due date), decision log (date+outcome), cross-workstream dependency map, scorecard (value-plan metrics + cost view). Status packets expected 24h before meeting.
